what_it_does: Electric vehicles use 48-volt power distribution systems requiring bidirectional switches (allowing current to flow in both directions). A single bidirectional GaN (gallium nitride) transistor is more area-efficient than two back-to-back transistors, but it risks overstress when switching off. This paper presents a monolithic bidirectional GaN load switch with dynamic gate-path selection that avoids overstress, plus inrush-current limiting and voltage-spike suppression for reliable, efficient power switching in EV systems.
